set.body:
Write the normative contract before public implementation.

Define orientations and composition for observations Y, compiled design X, condition-space effect functional, lowered target T, fixed or learned observation model, extractor E, relation family B, design receipt, and fit identity.

Separate dataset facts, scientific requests, statistical assumptions, execution receipts, and earned fit capabilities.

Specify semantic dependency hashing, route-stable relation_plan_id, realized fit identity, no tolerance-based identity, the raw X and T degenerate path, classed refusals, and the external compiler conformance schema.

Acceptance: contract includes positive laws, negative fixtures, ownership boundaries, versioned schemas, and explicit non-goals.
set.title: Phase 1: Specify the first-moment relation and ingestion contract
